name: Mornington Yacht Club
signature: The Peninsula's largest and most active yacht club — racing, junior sailing, and a harbour setting that makes Mornington's waterfront what it is
editorNote:
Mornington Yacht Club is one of the busiest sailing clubs on Port Phillip Bay — a large active membership, regular racing from the harbour, a strong junior program, and a clubhouse that has views across the bay to the You Yangs. The club runs dinghy and keelboat racing through the season and has one of the better learn-to-sail programs on the Peninsula for adults and children.

The harbour setting at Mornington is one of the most picturesque on the bay — the breakwater, the boats, and the bathing boxes all in frame together. Even non-sailors come to walk the harbour wall and watch the racing.
whyWeGo: The harbour at Mornington is the waterfront — the yacht club is the reason it has that atmosphere.
ifOnlyOneThing: Walk the Mornington Harbour breakwater on a Saturday morning when club racing is running.
